options.product: Microsoft Entra External ID - external tenant
options.configuration: Documentation research only; external tenant, not workforce or legacy Azure AD B2C

conditions: Confirm the commercial tier, tenant region and registered application before assigning scoped availability.
External-tenant OIDC must not be inferred from workforce-tenant or legacy Azure AD B2C settings.

evidence.summary: The external-tenant feature table lists OIDC, authorization code and PKCE. This is documentation-level support, not verification of a tenant configuration.

conditions: Distinguish outbound provisioning into a supported app from an inbound customer-directory SCIM endpoint.
Establish the required direction, entitlement, mapping and application-side deprovisioning behavior.

evidence.summary: The feature table describes automatic SCIM account synchronization with supported apps. That description alone does not establish an inbound SCIM service for this B2B scenario.

conditions: Token group claims and application-role assignments are not evidence of SCIM group lifecycle synchronization.
Confirm the target connector, direction, group membership changes and application enforcement.

evidence.summary: The external-tenant table separately describes groups, role assignments and group claims. These authorization features do not prove the required provisioning path.
